verdict.rationale: Thoropass says it 'connects evidence, progress, and auditors in one place from kickoff to final report' and that audit work 'from scoping through final report' happens in one platform. Evidence requests with comments, attachments and status updates, plus a Comments Inbox for controls and evidence requests, support replacing email threads with in-platform collaboration. However, the evidence never documents a dedicated, permission-scoped auditor role or view. It also never shows how auditors log in and see controls and evidence. Missing for 10: documented scoped auditor role/permissions, a description of the auditor-facing view of controls and evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
